svg.title: dubizzle Car Assistant system architecture
svg.desc: Streamlit exchanges HTTP and JSON with FastAPI. The chat workflow reads session and profile context from SQLite, interprets the request using Gemini when needed or the local parser, then runs backend actions against the catalog and booking rules. The Excel workbook loads into the in-memory catalog at startup. FastAPI saves the turn and confirmed bookings in SQLite before returning a response. A saved lead is exported from SQLite to a CSV file.
svg.metadata: Typography uses Google Sans by The Google Sans Project Authors under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans). Lettering is outlined to render consistently in standalone SVG images.
